caption: During setup, Send a welcome email to the employee is ticked by default before you add anyone. Untick it while you are still testing, or your staff get an email. The password field is hidden.
Every plan adds a $19.00 base fee per month on top of the price per employee: Starter $4.99, Pro $6.99 and Advanced $12.99. API access is only in Advanced.
With the welcome email unticked, both made up employees were added and their invites show Not sent.
Our core test: a shift from 9:00 to 10:30 AM entered by hand gives 1.500 regular hours on the October time card. The IP addresses are hidden.
Exporting employee profile details needs the Advanced Reporting add on at $2 per user a month; it is included in the Advanced and Enterprise plans.

On 19 November our trial still ran with no card or bank account added: Pro at $6.99 per employee a month plus the $19.00 base fee, paid annually, next billing date 11/26/2026. The receipt address is hidden.
